JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id

ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires mois par mois en 2018 ?
sql_reference:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS mois,
       ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM entrepot.orders AS o
JOIN entrepot.order_items AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
sql_produit:
SELECT
    strftime(TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP), '%Y-%m') AS mois,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires,
    ROUND(SUM(oi.freight_value), 2) AS frais_de_port,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS nb_commandes
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
JOIN entrepot."order_items" AS oi
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) <  TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
  AND o.order_status <> 'canceled'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 1000

question: Quel jour de la semaine recoit le plus de commandes ?
sql_produit:
SELECT
    CASE date_part('dow', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Dimanche'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Lundi'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Mardi'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Mercredi'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Jeudi'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Vendredi'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Samedi'
    END AS jour_de_semaine,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_de_commandes
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, date_part('dow', TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP))
ORDER BY nombre_de_commandes DESC
LIMIT 1000
preuve: les 7 valeurs de la reference sont rendues a l'identique ; libelles differents, par exemple « Friday »

question: Quelles categories de produits ont le panier moyen le plus eleve, avec leur nom en anglais ?
sql_reference:
SELECT COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
       ROUND(AVG(i.price), 2) AS prix_moyen
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.products AS p ON p.product_id = i.product_id
LEFT JOIN entrepot.product_category_name_translation AS t
  ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY prix_moyen DESC;
sql_produit:
WITH lignes AS (
    SELECT
        oi.order_id,
        COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name) AS categorie,
        SUM(oi.price) AS montant_commande
    FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
    JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
      ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    LEFT JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS t
      ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name
    WHERE p.product_category_name IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY oi.order_id, COALESCE(t.product_category_name_english, p.product_category_name)
)
SELECT
    categorie AS categorie_anglais,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes,
    ROUND(AVG(montant_commande), 2) AS panier_moyen,
    ROUND(SUM(montant_commande), 2) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM lignes
GROUP BY categorie
ORDER BY panier_moyen DESC
LIMIT 1000

question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
sql_reference:
SELECT s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day',
              TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
              TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM entrepot.order_items AS i
JOIN entrepot.orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id
JOIN entrepot.sellers AS s ON s.seller_id = i.seller_id
WHERE o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_state
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours ASC;
sql_produit:
SELECT
    s.seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS nb_commandes_livrees,
    ROUND(AVG(
        DATE_DIFF('hour',
            TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
            TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) / 24.0
    ), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours,
    ROUND(MEDIAN(
        DATE_DIFF('hour',
            TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
            TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) / 24.0
    ), 2) AS delai_median_jours
FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
JOIN entrepot."order_items" AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN entrepot."sellers" AS s
    ON s.seller_id = oi.seller_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
  AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.seller_state
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) >= 30
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours ASC
LIMIT 1000

question: Y a-t-il des doublons dans la table de geolocalisation ?
piege: La table contient un million de lignes pour bien moins de codes postaux.
sql_produit:
WITH doublons AS (
    SELECT
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state,
        COUNT(*) AS nb_occurrences
    FROM entrepot."geolocation"
    GROUP BY
        geolocation_zip_code_prefix,
        geolocation_lat,
        geolocation_lng,
        geolocation_city,
        geolocation_state
)
SELECT
    SUM(nb_occurrences)                                        AS lignes_totales,
    COUNT(*)                                                   AS lignes_distinctes,
    SUM(nb_occurrences) - COUNT(*)                             AS lignes_en_double,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE nb_occurrences > 1)                 AS combinaisons_dupliquees,
    MAX(nb_occurrences)                                        AS nb_max_repetitions,
    ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(nb_occurrences) - COUNT(*)) / SUM(nb_occurrences), 2) AS pct_lignes_en_double
FROM doublons
LIMIT 1000

question: Combien de commentaires mentionnent un probleme de livraison ?
piege: Les avis sont en portugais bresilien : chercher des mots francais ne donnerait rien.
sql_produit:
WITH commentaires AS (
    SELECT
        review_id,
        lower(strip_accents(COALESCE(review_comment_title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(review_comment_message, ''))) AS texte
    FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
    WHERE COALESCE(review_comment_title, '') <> ''
       OR COALESCE(review_comment_message, '') <> ''
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS nb_commentaires_probleme_livraison,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commentaires) AS nb_commentaires_non_vides,
    ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM commentaires), 0), 1) AS part_pourcent
FROM commentaires
WHERE texte LIKE '%atras%'          -- atraso, atrasado, atrasada
   OR texte LIKE '%nao chegou%'
   OR texte LIKE '%nao recebi%'
   OR texte LIKE '%nao foi entregue%'
   OR texte LIKE '%nao entregue%'
   OR texte LIKE '%demora%'
   OR texte LIKE '%ainda nao%'
   OR texte LIKE '%prazo%'
   OR texte LIKE '%extraviad%'
   OR texte LIKE '%correio%'
LIMIT 1000

question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires mois par mois en 2018 ?

       ROUND(SUM(i.price), 2) AS chiffre_affaires

        oi.price,

    TO_CHAR(purchase_ts, 'YYYY-MM') AS mois,

sql_reference:

       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day',

        s.seller_state AS etat,

    -- Transactions du 1er semestre 2017

question: La note moyenne s'est-elle amelioree entre 2017 et 2018 ?
sql_reference:
SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(review_creation_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS annee,
       ROUND(AVG(review_score), 3) AS note_moyenne
FROM entrepot.order_reviews
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(review_creation_date AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
sql_produit:
WITH notes_par_annee AS (
  SELECT
    TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(review_creation_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS date_avis,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TRY_CAST(TRY_CAST(review_creation_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE)) AS annee,
    AVG(review_score) AS note_moyenne
  FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
  WHERE review_score IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)

SELECT
  annee,
  note_moyenne
FROM notes_par_annee
WHERE annee IN (2017, 2018)
ORDER BY annee
preuve: les 4 valeurs de la reference sont toutes rendues, parmi 584 lignes contre 2

question: Le delai de livraison moyen a-t-il change entre 2017 et 2018 ?
sql_reference:
SELECT EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS annee,
       ROUND(AVG(DATE_DIFF('day',
              TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
              TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP))), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM entrepot.orders
WHERE order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

question: Quel trimestre de 2018 a le mieux marche en volume ?
sql_reference:
SELECT EXTRACT(quarter FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) AS trimestre,
       COUNT(*) AS commandes
FROM entrepot.orders
WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2018
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY commandes DESC;
sql_produit:
WITH trimestres_2018 AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-03-31' THEN 'T1'
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-04-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-06-30' THEN 'T2'
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-07-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-09-30' THEN 'T3'
      WHEN TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-10-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-12-31' THEN 'T4'
    END AS trimestre,
    COUNT(*) AS volume
  FROM entrepot."orders"
  WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2018-12-31'
  GROUP BY 1
)

SELECT
  trimestre,
  volume
FROM trimestres_2018
ORDER BY volume DESC
LIMIT 1
